query: INSERT INTO disk_inventory (serial, model, size_bytes, first_seen, last_seen) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (serial) DO UPDATE SET model = excluded.model, size_bytes = excluded.size_bytes, last_seen = MAX(disk_inventory.last_seen, excluded.last_seen) WHERE disk_inventory.last_seen <= excluded.last_seen - ? OR disk_inventory.model IS NOT excluded.model OR disk_inventory.size_bytes != excluded.size_bytes
